_comment: USD per million tokens. Keys are lowercase model ids or prefixes (longest prefix wins). Override with GM_BENCH_PRICING=<path>. Anthropic prices verified 2026-06-24; OpenAI prices verified 2026-07-04; Gemini prices verified 2026-07-11; TypeSafe jev launch price ($0.042 input, $0 output, described as possibly subsidized) recorded 2026-09-18 from launch coverage and matched the same day against OpenRouter's gateway-billed cost for a 580-call panel (input-only; reported output tokens billed at zero). GPT-6.1 Sol (Standard processing, short-context rates; $0.10 cached input, the same 272K tier) verified 2026-10-12 against developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol. GPT-6 Astra (Standard processing, short-context rates; $1 cached input, $12.50 cache writes, same 272K tier) verified 2026-10-13 against developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-astra. GPT-6 Luna and Sol (Standard processing, short-context rates) verified 2026-09-23 against https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing and the model pages developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-luna and gpt-6-sol (openai.com/api/pricing answered 403 to a scripted fetch that day); the model pages say prompts with more than 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output for the full request, recorded as long_context_input_tokens. GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna corrected 2026-09-23 from their model pages (were $2.50/$15 and $1/$6; now $2/$12 and $0.20/$1.20, cached $0.20 and $0.02, cache writes 1.25x input, same 272K tier). GPT-5.6 Sol is deliberately left at $5/$30: its model page lists $4/$20 as promotional pricing available at least through 2026-11-21, and this table pins undiscounted list rates. Claude Haiku 5.5 (global routing) verified 2026-10-13 against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing: $0.10 input, $0.125 5-minute cache writes, $0.20 1-hour cache writes, $0.01 cache hits, $0.50 output for prompts up to 100,000 tokens; a request whose prompt (cache reads and writes included) is over 100,000 tokens pays 5x on every category ($0.50, $0.625, $1, $0.05, $2.50) for the whole request, recorded as long_context_input_tokens. Claude Opus 5.5 (global routing) verified 2026-10-14 against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing: $4 input, $5 5-minute cache writes, $8 1-hour cache writes, $0.20 cache hits (0.05x input), $20 output; the full 1M context is at standard pricing, so no long-context tier. Fast mode ($8/$40) and US-only inference (1.1x) are not priced here. Without its own key it would match no entry and leave cost null. Claude Sonnet 5.5 verified 2026-10-13 against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing: $2 input, $2.50 5-minute cache writes, $4 1-hour cache writes, $0.10 cache hits (0.05x input, half Sonnet 5's), $10 output; the full 1M context is at standard pricing, so no long-context tier. Without its own key it would resolve to the claude-sonnet-5 prefix and price cache hits at $0.20. Claude Sonnet 5 corrected 2026-09-23 from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (was $3/$15; now $2 input, $10 output, $0.20 cache hits, $2.50 5-minute cache writes; the full 1M context is at standard pricing, so no long-context tier); its $4 1-hour cache-write rate (2x input) added 2026-09-24 from the same page. Meta Muse Spark 1.3 verified 2026-10-14 against https://dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits/: standard $1.25 input, $0.15 cached input, $4.25 output; Contributor tier (Meta may train on prompts and completions) $0.10 input, $0.002 cached input, $0.20 output, the same rates OpenCode Go charges for opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor; no cache-write price and no long-context premium. Optional fields, all USD per million tokens unless named otherwise: cached_input_per_mtok (cache-read rate), cache_write_per_mtok (cache-write rate; Anthropic's 5-minute tier), cache_write_1h_per_mtok (Anthropic's 1-hour cache-write rate; falls back to cache_write_per_mtok), long_context_input_tokens (per-request input size above which a long-context tier applies), verified (date the entry was checked), list_price_key (a discounted tier: agentic-redact's OpenCode list-price estimate prices its tokens at the named entry's undiscounted rates). estimate_cost_usd reads only input_per_mtok and output_per_mtok; the optional fields feed api_equivalent_cost_usd. Unknown models yield cost_usd=null, never a guess. OpenRouter rows (openrouter/<model>) are priced at the one host the OpenCode driver pins each to (gm_bench/agentic/opencode.py OPENROUTER_ROUTES), verified 2026-10-16 against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/<model>/endpoints: GLM-5.3-flash on Z.AI (fp8) $0.15 input, $0.03 cache reads, $0.50 output; MiMo-v2.6-flash on Xiaomi (fp8) $0.14, $0.0028, $0.28; MiMo-v2.6-pro on Xiaomi (fp8) $0.435, $0.0036, $0.87; DeepSeek-V4-Pro on StreamLake (fp8; OpenRouter lists no DeepSeek endpoint; first pinned to Baidu at $0.3667, $0.03038, $0.7335) at its undiscounted list rates $1.74, $0.145, $3.48, the same as DeepSeek's own: on 2026-10-16 StreamLake charged a promotional 84.67% off ($0.266742, $0.0222285, $0.533484), so a row's actual OpenRouter bill is that much lower while the promotion lasts. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on DeepInfra (fp8, standard tier) verified 2026-10-17 at its undiscounted list rates $0.20, $0.006, $0.60; that day DeepInfra charged a promotional 30% off ($0.14, $0.0042, $0.42). DeepSeek's own endpoint ($0.15, $0.003, $0.60 off-peak, doubled on weekdays 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC) is not pinned: it may train on prompts. No cache-write price and no long-context tier is listed for any of them. OpenCode Go models (opencode-go/<model>, priced by the id without the prefix) verified 2026-10-18 against the vendors' pages; OpenCode Go's catalog (models.dev) lists the same rates. Kimi K3 (platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing/chat): $3 input, $0.30 cache hits, $3 5-minute cache writes ($6 1-hour), $15 output, no context tier. GLM-5.3 (docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing): $1.40 input, $0.26 cached input, $4.40 output, cache storage free for a limited time, no context tier; GLM-5.3-flash gets its own key at the Z.AI rates above so it does not resolve to the glm-5.3 prefix. Qwen3.8-Max (alibabacloud.com model-pricing, International): $2 input, $6 output, one tier up to 1M tokens; the page does not state its cache rates, so the $0.25 cache reads and $2.50 cache writes are OpenCode Go's catalog figures. MiniMax-M3 (platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing, Standard tier, after a permanent 50% reduction): $0.30 input, $0.06 cache reads, $1.20 output up to 512K input tokens per request, doubled above it, recorded as long_context_input_tokens. Grok 4.7 (docs.x.ai/docs/models): $2 input, $0.50 cached input, $6 output; a request whose prompt reaches 200K tokens pays $4, $1 and $12 for the whole request, recorded as long_context_input_tokens.
